comments.author: @BeyondTheMapTV1
comments.text: What makes Siberia remarkable is that extreme cold changes almost every ordinary system we normally take for granted. ❄ Cars, plumbing, foundations, food storage and transportation all have to be designed around temperatures that can stay far below freezing for weeks. In places built on permafrost, even keeping a house warm becomes an engineering problem because warming the ground underneath can eventually damage the structure itself.
